LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_121496: Aidas is expert in ranged weapons such as guns and artillery. She does not gain Accumulator during battle and can't use Accumulator to cast skills, but can use Normal Attack 5 times on a single enemy in her round. Aidas' Normal Attack damage coefficient is 180% and ignores 80% enemy defense. After each Normal Attack, Damage will be increased by 25% and Crit Rate by 30% (absolute value), both up to 300% (absolute value) (reset when Aidas is killed). In enemy round, each time an ally is attacked, Aidas uses Normal Attack on the attacking enemy. In ally round, she cooperates with allies, using a Normal Attack on the enemy her ally is attacking. She uses a custom sniper cannon, having 40% chance to lock the target for 1 round (every Normal Attack in her round has the chance to lock the target; counter attacks and cooperative attacks may also lock enemies), and her attacks will not be blocked. At the start of battle, Aidas gains Eye of True Sight until the end. At the start of battle, she gains immunity to Lock, Freeze, Confuse, Petrify, Icebound, and Entangle for 3 rounds.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_328: What is the meaning of war?Recently, I've been waking up from nightmares, to find myself painfully moaning and gasping for breath. These sounds in my dreams are as clear as if I were awake. When I close my eyes, the disgusting pictures play again and again in front of me. But I'm not afraid since I'm a medic. No matter how badly a soldier is injured, as long as he is alive I still have a chance to save him. But I'm worried a lot and have no direction; I've started doubting the meaning, the meaning of everything.You don't have to save clones, they are just walking, nutrient solution.Louise would once argue with her mentor Natalie, always trying to persuade herself that only natural humans are real humans. But, afterwards her team was sent to participate in a cruel war and she then saw the horrors of war with her own eyes. With her own eyes, she saw deformed human clones thrown into alien zerg's culture pool to be taken apart. Then these clones were woken up from the cultivate cabins only to be forced to take up weapons and continue fighting. When she saw all this for herself with her own eyes, she renounced her previous ideas about clones.After Louise demonstrated her great medical skills, using her so-called noble natural human identity to her advantage, she finally got the permission to help heal the wounded human clones. Afterall, every human has the right to choose his right to live.No matter how just or righteous the war is claimed to be, these claims are just an elaborate facade which can't cover over the reality of the truth. Who can benefit from a war? Not the citizens, not the soldiers. The vested interest groups always sit in a safe position and play the game on their chessboard. What about the others? They are simply just the chess pieces on the board.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_131511: Being the most acclaimed football player in the Galaxy Empire, Lenish excels at any position. When placed in the front row of a defensive lineup, he becomes a forward and his skill is replaced by [World Wave!]' when placed in the second row of a defensive lineup, he becomes a midfielder and his skill is replaced by [Pinpoint Pass]; when placed in the third row, he becomes a defender and his skill is replaced by [Tackle!]. World Wave!: Cross attack, first clears all buffs from the target, then plunders 65% of their Penetration and Accumulator and deals 420% S-ATK damage. The first attack also deals 120% S-ATK True Damage to all enemies. You gain 40% increased damage and 100% increased Crit ATK each time the skill is used for 3 rounds, stacking up to 120% damage and 300% Crit ATK. Self gains 2 rounds of invisibility and will not lose invisibility for as long as there is another allied unit alive (can be seen by Eye of True Sight). Lenish's skill attacks have a 60% chance to crit (guaranteed to crit when triggered). Lastly, you recover 150 Accumulator. Pinpoint Pass: Cross attack, deals 300% S-ATK damage. Targets the ally with the highest attack (the highest of ATK or S-ATK) except for self to clear their crowd-control effects and debuffs and enable them to act 1 extra time this round (does not stack with similar effects), while also increasing their Penetration by 150%, damage dealt by 80% and granting them a new skill effect lasting 1 round: deals 230% S-ATK True Damage the enemy with the least HP. Makes the crowd-control effects and debuffs of the next acting unit (does not count extra actions gained from skills) go through immunity and protection effects for 1 round. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator. Tackle!: Cross attack, deals 260% S-ATK damage and plunders 80% of the target's S-DEF and DEF for 2 rounds. Applies a Shield absorbing 400M damage to all allies (shield effects do not stack and the latest one overrides previous shields) for 2 rounds. (If Lenish's shield is active when the enemy attacks, the ally is protected and is immune to debuffs and some crowd-control effects: Freeze, Lock, Confuse and Forbidding Skill Use). All allies also gain Eye of True Sight for 2 rounds. Has a 50% chance to revive all allies with HP and Accumulator equal to 100% of their initial state (probability calculated individually for each unit; isn't affected by forbidding revival effects). Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_345: Perhaps it can be said that a hero must have the ability to make choices decisively at critical moments. After all, it's character that determines fortune, isn't it? But I'm far away from being a hero.In Empire Year-753, Joya and her team were sent to Felix Sector to arrest a group of arms smugglers. At the same time, I was entrusted by Elite Fleet to follow them secretly as secure, backup assurance.You'll never believe what I saw: a huge swarm of Killer Bees! These particular Killer Bees weren't just your ordinary, run-of-the-mill arms smugglers, but it turned out they were a team of doggone Protector of Truth! I hurried to turn off the engine and hide my ship in an asteroid belt while Joya and her team were surrounded by hundreds of Killer Bees!A battle is always short: Lock, fire and evacuate... So I thought those Killer Bees would just as before, take off as right after quickly slaughtering, that was until I saw a blazing light spreading from the central part of the battle field. Electromagnetic radiation passed through my body and turned off all electronic devices on my ship.It was my first time to observe the space of the universe without the help of the AR screen. I could see nothing but darkness, and the light was also fading away. My knowledge told me that sound couldn't transmit in the vacuum of outer space, but I was sure I could clearly hear the explosion which happened far away. It was like a beating heart... beating and then gradually turning into silence.Fortunately, I was found by the Support Fleet.Since the rest of the Protector of Truth smugglers were on the run in all directions committing crimes, the Empire desperately needed a Hero to restore the confidence of our citizens. What could be better than a commander who was both a handsome natural human and had also... destroyed dozens of Killer Bees?As if overnight, I quickly became the idol for all young men and women and a model example for all Empire soldiers. The moment I was sworn-in to Elite Fleet was displayed over and over again on every screen. At this moment, the Empire became united once again.Although, it's possible the sacrificed hero may come back to the battle field in clone form a few years later from now, the real honor can only be given to a real, natural human...
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_347: Star Lord used to be the owner of Kingdom of Fairy Tales, a toy company on Planet Laney. He designed many toys which was a source of great joy to the local children. Perhaps his unkind face made him look scary, but in fact he was quite a genial guy. Children of Planet Laney always called him Uncle Big Mouth.Every year, on Christmas Eve, Star Lord would dress as Santa Clause and carry large gift boxes as presents for children. It must have been the happiest day of the year for children on Planet Laney who couldn't afford toys. Whats more, Star Lord was also a children rights activist. He expended himself to fight space pirates and he saved many abducted children. His toy company would also take in war orphans.On the one hand, Star Lord had a great reputation in the world of philanthropy; but on the other hand, space pirates just wanted him dead. In time, they finally found their chance at revenge. In a rescue operation, Star Lord was misled by space pirate's bait to Palle, a constellation 5 light years away from Planet Laney. In the end, the space pirates destroyed Star Lord's toy company by leveling it to the ground by the use of proton canons. When Star Lord finally returned, Kingdom of Fairy Tales, the flagship building of Planet Laney, had already been burnt to the ground. Smelly children body parts and a half pair of silver goggles were the only things he found in the ruins.Since then, Star Lord has disappeared. Some people say a red ship was found in Elemental Phase which was far far away; another said a blue worm with one eye came into his toy shop; others said... anyway, it doesn't matter, nobody cares about it now. However, it's obvious that space pirates are getting fewer and fewer.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_121536: Cross attack; deals 320% S-ATK damage. Amanda has a 50% chance each to cast [Fervent Dance] and [Dance of Joy] whenever she casts a skill. Once she's cast each skill at least once, she'll instead cast [Revelry Tide] for the remainder of that battle (does not reset upon death).[Fervent Dance]: Select a random allied unit of a class based on the following order: Destroyer, Striker, Ranger, Flagship, Rover or Protector (target is chosen in descending order if none of the previous class can be found) and apply a shield lasting 1 round that blocks 1 attack, has a 100% chance to enable the unit to act again on its next round but deal 40% less damage on that extra action (does not stack with similar effects, extra 1 action will not take effect on itself), and gives it an extra effect lasting 1 round: if the target is a Destroyer, Striker or Ranger, it deals 1.5% extra damage for each 1% of max HP it is missing; if the target is a Protector, Rover or Flagship, its skills removes the target's buffs, after which they have a 50% chance to Confuse the enemy for 1 round. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.[Dance of Joy]: Heal all allies for 40% of max HP and cleanse debuffs and crowd-control effects (Freeze, Lock, Confuse, Petrify, Icebound, Entangle, Weaken) and Forbidding Skill Use. All allies also gain 40% S-ATK damage reduction for 2 rounds. Has a 50% chance to revive dead allies to 100% of their initial HP and Accumulator (probability calculated individually for each unit). Has a 50% chance to make all allies invisible (probability calculated individually for each unit) for 1 round. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.[Revelry Tide]: Has the effects of both [Fervent Dance] and [Dance of Joy].
LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_121459: Cross Attack, deals 320% S-ATK damage to targets. Has a 70% chance to make the target consume an extra 50% Accumulator to cast skills, lasting for 1 round. Gives 3 random allied ships a 75% chance, lasting for 2 rounds, to cause the same effect to a random enemy, which lasts for 1 round and ignores immunity, when inflicted with control effects (Freeze, Confuse, Lock, Forbidding Skill Use, Entangle). Has an 80% chance to make allied heroes of a certain class ignore enemy immunity or protection against their skills with control effects (Freeze, Lock, Confuse, Forbidding Skill Use, Entangle, Petrify, Icebound) or debuffs (Poison, Weaken) for 1 round (Priority of Hero Class: Striker, Ranger, Destroyer, Rover, Protector, Flagship. If heroes of a certain class are dead or missing, next class will be chosen in the order of priority). Has a 100% chance to instantly destroy a random enemy ship upon death for 2 rounds. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_111530: Janus has two personalities and switches between his [Offensive] and [Protective] personalities each time he acts, each having its own skill (You can in the Formation menu choose whether to start the battle in his [Offensive] or [Protective] personality). [Offensive]: Deals 340% S-ATK damage and follows up with 3 further attacks, each dealing 320% S-ATK damage and 4M True Damage to a random enemy unit. Attacks 1 extra time for each extra 50 Accumulator spent during the skill cast, up to 9. If Janus has more than 200 Accumulator when casting the skill, the attack cannot be blocked, and if more than 400 Accumulator, the attack is guaranteed to crit. Janus' skill attacks ignore 40% of the enemy's DEF and S-DEF. The skill's damage increases by 0.5% for each Accumulator above 100 spent during the skill cast. Using the skill changes his personality to [Protective]. Lastly, he recovers 100 Accumulator. [Protective]: Recover 55% of max HP when switching to [Protective] personality and gain a shield equal to 200% of max HP (does not stack) lasting 1 round. He also gains 65% damage reduction, and allies gain 40%, for 1 round. He gains 100% DEF and S-DEF for 1 round. His block is increased by 100% (absolute value) for 1 round. Janus also gains Accumulator equal to 60% of the Accumulator cost of any skill not cast by himself for 1 round. He can gain up to 600 Accumulator per round this way. Janus is also cleared of all control effects on his next round before acting. [Protective] Active Skill: Does not attack but restores the max HP of all allies by 55% and has a 100% chance to reveal all invisible enemies. Janus himself gains Rebirth for 2 rounds, and is healed to 100% of his initial HP and Accumulator on rebirth, and has a 50% chance to revive dead allies (probability calculated individually for each unit), restoring them to 100% of their initial HP and Accumulator. Janus gains immunity to Accumulator Reduction for 2 rounds and invisibility for 1 round. Janus also gains [Dark Invisibility] (cannot be attacked or targeted by skills) for 1 round after casting a skill while at 600 or more Accumulator. Janus also gains a shield that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage (including instant death) for 1 round. He then switches to his [Offensive] personality. Skills cast while in his [Protective] personality do not cost Accumulator (but he needs to have at least 100 Accumulator to cast). Janus gains an extra 300 Accumulator at the start of battle. If he starts the battle in [Offensive] personality, he gains invisibility for 1 round and a shield that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage (including instant death) for 1 round. Janus follows up with 7 extra attacks the first time he casts the skill. If he starts the battle in [Protective] personality, he gains a shield equal to 200% of his max HP (does not stack) lasting 1 round. He also gains 65% damage reduction, and allies gain 40%, for 1 round. He gains 100% DEF and S-DEF for 1 round. His block is increased by 100% (absolute value) for 1 round. Janus also gains Accumulator equal to 60% of the Accumulator cost of any skill not cast by himself for 1 round. He can gain up to 600 Accumulator per round this way. Janus gains immunity to Accumulator Reduction for 2 rounds, and is also cleared of all control effects on his next round before acting. Note: When Janus is revived or rebirths, he returns to battle in the personality chosen from the Formation menu.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_488: On February 14 of the 362nd year of the Galaxy Empire, a siren princess was accused of seducing Rasyon on the Valentine's Day celebration. For this crime, Queen Freya exiled her. The sirens dared not stand up for their princess as the Empire was mighty, and Queen Freya had control over their economy. In silence, they watched their princess be taken to the Water Dungeon in the shadowy depths of the Galaxy... 60 years passed, and most living had forgotten about the princess and her predicament. Yet, interstellar travelers that pass by the dungeon sometimes see bubbles rising from it and hear a soul-rending song of lamentation.!@#That was until one day when the brave Honorary Captain 莹莹她爹.s469, Honorary Vice-Captain Lilithwomyn1.s448 and Honorary Vice-Captain killerchris.s46 heard the soul-rending song of lamentation...
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_485: "The Elderly died from Untold Enigma. And that only points to you." Yone finally understood why he was accused of murder. He'd like to explain himself to his brother and ask for forgiveness, but brother had been dead in his arms...!@#When the war broke out, Yone, who was supposed to protect the Elderly, left his position to solve other problems, and came back only to find the Elderly lying in his own blood. Thus, he was accused of murder. A once-promising warrior, Yone had become a traitor despised by all. But he evaded arrest and searched the entire Galaxy, only to find the true murderer. Meanwhile, his brother—once his ally—was after him. When the two finally confronted each other, his brother demanded Yone either go back and face the trial, or leave after killing him. But brother was no match for Yone, and there was no rounding back...!@#Three Commanders—Silukirp.s461, Honorary Captain, Mielu.s72, Honorary Vice-Captain, Dumboot.s849, Honorary Vice-Captain—have found something odd about the case in its investigation, and decided to look for the true murderer with Yone.
LC_EVENT_xunzhang_weekly_1_10: Draw a 10x Exploration in Empire Soldier
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_482: Scientists have discovered a unique and shadowy planet. Located in the darkest corner of the galaxy, away from bright stars, this planet betrayed no light. Yet a place that should be black as night is miraculously flooded with a dark purple. And so it has come to be known as Chaos.!@#It was a paradise for adventurers.!@#No one knew how much resources Chaos contained. Its extreme conditions gave rise to unusually rich resources, and the first explorer who set foot on the planet was blown away by epic Galactonite showers.!@#Everyone flocked to the planet, mining in huge quantities, taking advantage of seemingly inexhaustible resources, and breeding wars.!@#Over time, brutal wars took away countless lives, and over-exploitation led to depleted resources. People left and the planet was quiet once more.!@#Chaos became a forbidden zone, a hell in space.!@#Its consciousness awoke from slumber to a shattered self, facing only chaos and wreckage left by years of war.!@#It vowed to destroy those who dared to exploit it. They will all pay for what they've done.!@#Chaos revived the bodies strewn about its surface, turning them into an army of Dark Heroes. Placed into remnant ships, these Dark Heroes were sent to infiltrate other planets, carrying with them Chaos' consciousness and a deadly plague.!@#Bolstered by Chaos, the plague brought by Dark Heroes ravaged other planets. Cries and howls sounded across the galaxy. All those infected came under its control, creating a legion of darkness. These Dark Legions were then sent to collect the blood of Legendary Heroes, spawning armies of legendary Dark Heroes. Although not as powerful as Legendary Heroes themselves, these dark counterparts were still a force to be reckoned with.!@#Using his army and the plague, Chaos took over countless planets, delighting in the tumult.!@#But, before long, a commander named Vaccine stepped forward and ended the plague.!@#Chaos' army suffered heavy losses.!@#From then on, Chaos saw Vaccine as its arch-nemesis and vowed to bring the entire galaxy under the shadow of darkness.
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_480: Following the war on the planet MK589, Honorary Captain — 虞美人.s344, Honorary Vice-Captain — Nopo.s819 and Honorary Vice-Captain — Rotyken.s819 found the dismembered body of their ally. They rebuilt it and named it No.1113, the ID of their former team. No.1113 awoke with his mind a fragmented mess, his whole being hell-bent on destruction. A series of questions arose within: Who am I? Where am I? Who am I supposed to attack?

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_1503: Cross attack, deals 240% S-ATK damage. Lucy gains 1 Warp Energy whenever an ally uses a skill and 1 Warp Energy for every 3rd allied Normal Attack. Warp Energy stacks up to 7, each stack giving Lucy 5% damage reduction and 10% DEF and S-DEF. If Lucy uses a skill when at 7 stacks of Warp Energy, Lucy expends all stacks and increases the damage of the ally with the highest attack (the highest of ATK and S-ATK) by 40% for 2 rounds. Debuffs and status effects of the ally with the highest attack are also cleared before acting next (does not apply to extra actions on the original turn), and it can attack 2 times in a row. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.
LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_11947: Vertical attack, deals 300% S-ATK damage to targets which get hit; increases 80% Crit Rate for the team for 1 round and activate shields for all allies; the shield can reduce 85% received damage for 2 rounds. It can also recover 65 Accumulator for all teammates and recover 100 Accumulator for self. If Buzzer has less than 80% HP when releases this skill, it will become invisible for 1 round, and increase DEF and S-DEF by 450% for 1 round; in addition, heal self by 50% of the S-ATK damage dealt.
LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_1507: Vertical attack, deal 240% S-ATK damage, and Protects all allies for 2 rounds. Protect: Increases damage reduction by 35% and DEF and S-DEF equal to 40% of DeRosa's initial defenses. 40% of damage taken (excluding instant death) is transferred to DeRosa (damage reduction effects work on damage sustained this way; instant death effects and damage taken by DeRosa cannot be transferred to other units). The damage DeRosa takes for others and his HP will be recorded (resets to 0 upon death or when triggering explosion damage) up to 75% of DeRosa's max HP. Upon stacking up to 75%, an explosion is triggered that deals S-ATK damage equal to the accrued value to all enemy units (explosion damage is affected by damage boosts and damage reduction). The effect of Protect does not work when DeRosa is Confused or crowd-controlled (e.g., Locked, Frozen, Petrified, etc.). Also heals DeRosa and all allies for 25% of DeRosa's max HP and renders all allies immune to instant death for 2 rounds. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator. At the start of battle, DeRosa's max HP is increased by 25% and DEF and S-DEF by 15% for the remainder of the battle.

LC_HULL_Hull_Improvement_help: You can lock starships or unlock those you have manually locked. Locked starships cannot be used as material or decomposed but can be augmented.!@#Tap the Batch Merge button to merge all your 3-star and below starships, merging up to 4-star ones.!@#Starship Modification!@#!@#Modifications: New materials will greatly strengthen your Starships and their attributes. The star level of Starships ranges from 1 to 10 stars, and their color goes from yellow to orange after 5 stars. A green up arrow means it's available for modification. Tap a certain Starship to automatically enter the modification interface. Unlocked Starships can be used as modification materials which can be put in the second or third grid. Those Starships that cannot be used as materials will be locked.!@#Modification Materials: Starships, Starship Cores.!@#How to Equip: After you get Starships, you will be required to equip them in your fleet or Fleet League. Equipped Starships can bring you amazing attributes. Starships won't be replaced if Heroes change.!@#Note: Starships used as materials will be consumed and cannot use equipped Starships as materials. Starship Cores are required for increasing star level of 4-star or above Starships.

LC_MENU_SA_StarTrekBudo_HELP_TEXT: 1. The top 512 players of the Stellar Voyage Arena Courage Ranking are automatically signed up for the Voyage Competition.!@#2. Each competition comprises three phases: Selections, Group and Finals.!@#3. The Selections are played in rounds, and you can set up a lineup for each round. Several powerful commanders will be promoted from each round to play in the Round of 32. Competition matchups will be decided by the system. Following the elimination, you can check the results of your battles. Each victory during this phase grants you rewards.!@#4. Following the Selections, 256 will be promoted to the Group phase and divided into 8 groups. Groups are played as Best of 3 elimination, and each group's champion will be further promoted.!@#5. Each group's champion gets promoted to the finals, in which the Voyage Competition's winner will ultimately be crowned.!@#6. All players can use Voyage Competition Coins to show their favorite player their Support in every match held during the Group and Finals phases in an attempt to earn more Voyage Competition Coins.!@#7. The Round of 32 phase will be played in two rounds over 1 day, with one battle being played every 4 hours. Participants may edit their lineups at any time before a battle begins.!@#8. The semi-finals and finals are played as Best of 5. The winners will receive the Empire's greatest honor.!@#9. Neither paintcoat buffs nor Star Alliance buffs from Conquer the Cosmos take effect during the competition.!@#10、The multiplier changes based on Voyage Competition Coins used in support. It can drop down to 1.2 if enough Coins support a player, or go as high as 10 if fewer Coins are used in support.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_121401: Cross attack, deals 400% S-ATK damage; activates the Eye of True Sight for self so that it can attack invisible enemies, lasting until the end of the battle. Also increases its Crit and Hit Rate by 150%, for 2 rounds; reduces targets' Anti Crit and Hit Rate by 150%, for 2 rounds. Summons 2 doppelganger ships into the battle to join the attack sequence. The doppelganger will have the main ship's opening stats (except speed) x88%. The doppelganger can launch a vertical attack, dealing 220% damage. Randomly selects 3 friendly ships (can be the same unit), and each unit will have a 50% chance to gain the following effects (probability for each effect calculated separately): become invisible for 1 round, become immune to Lock for 2 rounds, become immune to frozen status for 2 rounds; Randomly selects 3 enemy ships (can be the same unit), and each unit will have a 50% chance to receive the following effects (probability for each effect calculated separately): invisible unit exposed, locked for 1 round, frozen for 1 round. The main ship links with its doppelgangers and, for every doppelganger destroyed, increases its ATK damage and S-ATK damage by 50%, lasting until the end of the battle (damage can stack). Also has a 40% chance to trigger each of the following effects: Forbids the usage of 1 of the enemy's skills for 1 round; Weakens 1 enemy unit, reducing all of its starts by 50% for 1 round; Confuses 1 random enemy for 1 round; Poisons 1 random enemy for 2 rounds, dealing 280% S-ATK damage per round; Makes 1 random ally enter Stasis for 1 round, preventing lethal damage; Makes 1 random ally Invisible for 1 round; Restores 40% HP for the ally with the least HP; Applies a Shield lasting 2 rounds with a potency equal to Doppelganger's Attack * 280% to a random ally. Doppelgangers cannot be reborn or revived. Each doppelganger can last up to 2 rounds, and there can be 4 doppelgangers max in the sequence. Doppelgangers will not take the position of already defeated ships. If there are already 4 doppelgangers in the sequence, no more will be summoned. After that, the Hero has a 100% chance to become invisible for 2 rounds. After the attacks, the ship has a 100% chance to enter stasis state for 1 round. When in stasis state, the ship can withstand lethal damage one time. In addition, increases 100 Accumulator for the ship itself.

LC_MENU_MEDAL_Remould_Help: 1. Attribute modification: enhance and upgrade a high-quality Medal to improve its basic attributes. The Medal Modification function is now available with the advancement of galactic technology. Players may repeatedly modify Medals' basic attributes to obtain the best combination of attribute bonuses. Modifying attributes consumes a large amount of cosmic energy, so players will need to use special Modifying Devices to do so.!@#2. Attribute lock: while modifying, our technicians can lock and save the attributes you select. But as this is a high-precision operation, we'll need the special item, "Lock Shield", to ensure its success.!@#3. Max attribute bonus percentage: each attribute can get up to 150% bonus from modifications.!@#4. Saving results: the bonus value of the current modification will replace the previous bonus value. (Note: bonus values are replaced, not stacked. This is different from the Module Adjustment function). These actions cannot be undone, please proceed with caution.!@#5. Attribute value display: the value inside the parentheses indicates the currently saved bonus percentage. The value outside the parentheses indicates the final bonus percentage after the current modification.!@#6. Costs: each attribute modification costs 1 Modifying Device. In modifications, it costs 1 Lock Shield per locked attribute.

LC_MENU_WD_HELP: 1. Introduction: Conquer the Cosmos is a cross-server battle, the final winner will own a planet. You can see all planets in the past on War Declare Interface and Monument Interface.!@#2. Event Time: The Conquer the Cosmos is a monthly event and each time it will last for 2 days.!@#3. Requirements: Your Alliance must be at least Lv. 2 and have at least 2 members before you can participate in Conquer the Cosmos. All Participants will get abundant rewards from the Empire.!@#4. War Declaration and Matchup: Any Alliance member can declare a war during the event. The system will automatically match an opponent Alliance with similar Force so you can have a worthy competition.!@#5. Asgard Fortress: Asgard Fortress can protect the Alliance's property during the event, but the Fortress’s level will be decreased by 1 after each war.!@#6. Protector: Chairman or Vice Chairman can appoint a Protector for the Alliance. The other Alliance members won’t get attacked before the Protector got defeated. A Protector have 4 HP, and it will recover at the beginning of each battle， A common attack will consume 1 HP, but the protector will lose all HP once defeated， Protector can be resurrected， Protector will lose 2 HP even the Protector win a Violent Attack.!@#7. Battle Supply: Each player has 160x Battle Supplies at the beginning of the Conquer the Cosmos event. Any attack will consume a certain amount of Battle Supplies. Battle Supplies will be restored by 1 point every 6 minutes with a maximum of 160 points.!@#8. Merit: Attack opponent Alliance’s Fortress and members will be rewarded with Merit. The Alliance which has the most Merit will claim the final victory! Attack Fortress to get 10 Merit， attack Fortress Core to get 10 Merit， attack the Protector or an opponent player to get 20-40 Merit for a victory (according to the level gap between players) and 10 Merit for a failure and the defenders will not receive any Merit if it fails. Only a small amount of Merit can be obtained from attacking the protector or an opponent player if the Fortress of the opponent Alliance has’t been destroyed.!@#9. Attack: Players can choose [Attack] or [Violent Attack]， Attack: It takes 1 Battle Supply each time， Violent attack: It takes 4 Battle Supplies each time. In a Violent Attack, your basic attributes will be doubled and a victory is ensured against all opponent players except the Protector. Players’ information can only be checked after an attack. Note: 10x Attack won't take effect on violent attack. Once you checked the button, you will spend 10 times of the required battle supplies to obtain 10 times of the basic Merits. If the remaining supplies are less than 10, your Credit will be spent first. Please make sure you have turned on the Credits Spending Tips in Settings.!@#10. Reward: There are two types of rewards, Individual Ranking Reward and Alliance Ranking Reward. And the reward will be sent when the event is over. All Alliance members can claim a reward if the Alliance’s ranking reached the reward requirement.!@#11. Other: During the event, players cannot join, dismiss or quit Alliance. After declaring war, the Protector can’t be changed and the Fortress can’t be upgraded either. Good luck, Commanders! For Empire’s Honor!!@#12 Note!@#When each battle ends, all members from the victorious Alliance will receive double Merits. All members from the defeated Alliance will get the normal amount of Merits. If a tie, both sides will get the normal amount of Merits. Please check your Battle Report. There must be more than two Alliances to declare war. Alliances will be matched in 6 minutes after the declaration of war. If no proper Alliance opponent, an additional 4 minutes will be spent attempting to match. If there is still no proper opponent, the match will be cancelled. Then you need to tap 'Declare' again to match.!@#When the season starts, you will inherit 1% of Merit from the last season.!@#When the season ends, all members from the champion Alliance across all servers will receive a 20% HP bonus on basic HP. This bonus will be added onto each deployed ship in the form of a Shield. It will last until the next season starts and only benefit Alliance members.

LC_FLEET_ADJUTANT_SKILL_DES_517501: At the start of a battle, applies a buff to 3 random allies. They have a 100% chance to cleanse control effects before acting each round (Freeze, Lock, Confuse, Petrify, Icebound, Entangle, and Forbidding Skill Use) and Weaken for 2 rounds (disappears on death; will not cleanse buffs).
LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_1440: Trigger Energy Transfer at the start of battle to link yourself and two allies with enemies in the following order: yourself and enemy with the most HP (absolute value) are linked; the ally with the most S-ATK and enemy with the most S-ATK are linked; the ally with the least HP (absolute value) and enemy with the least HP (absolute value) are linked. A single target may only have one Energy Transfer effect at a time (targets with an active link are removed from the calculation of new links). Energy Transfer has the following effects while active:When inflicted with control effects (Freeze, Lock, Confuse, Petrify, Entangle), the linked ally transfers them to the linked enemy instead (the linked ally is not affected by these control effects). Disregards any immunities.50% of enemy's attack damage taken by the linked ally (except lethal damage) is transferred to the linked enemy. This damage cannot be reduced or spread across different enemies, and ignores shields.Energy Transfer lasts for 2 rounds, and no more than 3 Energy Transfers may be active at any one time. Active Energy Transfers are cleared each time Energy Transfer triggers, and three new links are established.Vertical Attacks deal 340% S-ATK damage, and grant the ally with the least HP a shield able to negate one instance of fatal damage for 1 round. There is a 50% chance that enemies linked with allies are unable to deal damage or inflict status effects to allied units they are linked to for 1 round. Allies also leech 40% of linked enemies' stats (apart from Speed, HP, and Accumulator) for 1 round, as well as 20M HP (directly; this damage cannot be reduced or spread across different enemies, and ignores shields) from all linked enemies and transfer an amount equal to this to all linked allies before recovering 100 Accumulator.
LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_1441: Vertical attack; before attacking targets, activates Eye of True Sight until the end of battle. First plunders 70% Hit Rate and 70% Penetration from targets for 1 round, then deals 360% S-ATK damage and 10M True Damage. Then, deals 180% of the previous total damage (True Damage) to the enemy with the lowest HP. In order of priority, forbids enemy heroes of a certain class to use their skills for 99 rounds, the order being Striker, Rover, Protector, Flagship, then Ranger (if the highest priority class is missing or destroyed, then the next class in line will be selected). Then, there's an 80% chance of becoming invisible for 2 rounds, immune to Forbidding Skill Use for 2 rounds, and immune to Accumulator Reduce effects for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_121531: Janus has two personalities and switches between his [Offensive] and [Protective] personalities each time he acts, each having its own skill (You can in the Formation menu choose whether to start the battle in his [Offensive] or [Protective] personality). [Offensive]: Deals 360% S-ATK damage and follows up with 3 further attacks, each dealing 340% S-ATK damage and 6M True Damage to a random enemy unit. Attacks 1 extra time for each extra 40 Accumulator spent during the skill cast, up to 10. Each follow-up attack deals extra True Damage equal to 15% of the target's current HP. If Janus has more than 100 Accumulator when casting the skill, the attack cannot be blocked, and if more than 300 Accumulator, the attack is guaranteed to crit. Janus' skill attacks ignore 50% of the enemy's DEF and S-DEF. The skill's damage increases by 0.8% for each Accumulator above 100 spent during the skill cast. Using the skill changes his personality to [Protective]. Lastly, he recovers 100 Accumulator. [Protective]: Recover 60% of max HP when switching to [Protective] personality and gain a shield equal to 230% of max HP (does not stack) lasting 1 round. He also gains 70% damage reduction, and allies gain 50%, for 1 round. He gains 120% DEF and S-DEF for 1 round. His block is increased by 100% (absolute value) for 1 round. Janus also gains Accumulator equal to 70% of the Accumulator cost of any skill not cast by himself for 1 round. He can gain up to 600 Accumulator per round this way. Janus is also cleared of all control effects on his next round before acting. [Protective] Active Skill: Does not attack but restores the max HP of all allies by 60% and has a 100% chance to reveal all invisible enemies. Janus himself gains Rebirth for 2 rounds, and is healed to 100% of his initial HP and Accumulator on rebirth, and has a 55% chance to revive dead allies (probability calculated individually for each unit; unaffected by forbidding revival effects), restoring them to 100% of their initial HP and Accumulator. Janus gains immunity to Accumulator Reduction for 2 rounds and invisibility for 1 round. Janus also gains [Dark Invisibility] (cannot be attacked or targeted by skills) for 1 round after casting a skill while at 500 or more Accumulator. Janus also gains a shield that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage (including instant death) for 1 round. He then switches to his [Offensive] personality. Skills cast while in his [Protective] personality do not cost Accumulator (but he needs to have at least 100 Accumulator to cast). Janus gains an extra 300 Accumulator at the start of battle as well as Eye of True Sight for 99 rounds. If he starts the battle in [Offensive] personality, he gains invisibility for 1 round and a shield that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage (including instant death) for 1 round. Janus follows up with 7 extra attacks the first time he casts the skill. If he starts the battle in [Protective] personality, he gains a shield equal to 230% of his max HP (does not stack) lasting 1 round. He also gains 70% damage reduction, and allies gain 50%, for 1 round. He gains 120% DEF and S-DEF for 1 round. His block is increased by 100% (absolute value) for 1 round. Janus also gains Accumulator equal to 70% of the Accumulator cost of any skill not cast by himself for 1 round. He can gain up to 600 Accumulator per round this way. Janus gains immunity to Accumulator Reduction for 2 rounds. Janus deals 40% increased damage when fighting non-Player units. While in [Protector] personality, Janus is also cleared of all control effects on each round before acting. Note: When Janus is revived or rebirths, he returns to battle in the personality chosen from the Formation menu.

LC_MENU_star_help: Stellar Voyage!@#After the Battle of the White Star was settled, a short peacetime arrived in the Galaxy. But the battle has cost the Galaxy too much; the shortage of resources poses a threat to the Empire. Crime rates are on the rise and the government is corrupt. Naturally, people are taking to the streets to protest. At this critical moment, Prof. Dexter announced an exciting message: he had found a planet of abundant resources 100,000 light-years away. Arrive there and you can assume ownership of it...!@#The entire Galaxy is boiling with excitement...!@#And that includes you, of course...!@#!@#Event Time: 2023-2-01 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2023-2-12 23:59:59 (UTC)!@#Details:!@#①During the event you'll create and send a Fleet to Solaris. As you advance on your journey, you may battle pirates, explore lost ruins for resources, and purchase supplies from Stellar Merchants using Voyage Commemorative Coins. But that's not all: two mighty pirate leaders await your challenge in each region. Besides, you're also likely to run into fleets of other players...!@#②Each warp forward costs 10 Voyage Energy and takes you 100 AU. Complete events there to earn Voyage Commemorative Coins! You can also use an Ion Propeller when warping forward, granting you 3x the Voyage Commemorative Coins upon completing the next event!!@#③Your Fleet starts with 500 Voyage Energy. You recover 1 Energy every 120 seconds up to the maximum limit. You can also use Voyage Energy Packs to gain more (Voyage Energy gained this way can exceed the maximum limit).!@#④You can use your Radar throughout the voyage to search for other players in the vicinity within that region. Once found, you can gift them Voyage Energy Supplies or try to plunder their Voyage Energy! Naturally, others may gift or plunder Energy from you too! You can always activate an Energy Shield to prevent others from attacking!!@#⑤You'll encounter pirates of 10 different levels. Higher-leveled pirates are more powerful but also grant more Voyage Commemorative Coins upon defeat! Should you find a battle too difficult, you can always spend 50 Voyage Energy to launch a Devastating Blast and gain mighty buffs!!@#⑥A mighty pirate leader can be found every 5,000 AU. You can use Voyage Energy or Voyage Arena Tickets to attack pirate leaders. You'll then receive great rewards from the Galaxy Empire based on the damage you deal. Six legendary heroes divided into two groups have been empowered by the Empire and will deal 500% increased damage to pirate leaders!!@#⑦You'll always encounter a Stellar Merchant 100 AU before a pirate leader. These merchants trade in Voyage Commemorative Coins and provide powerful supplies. You can also spin the Assault Wheel with Assault Tickets to earn tons of Voyage Commemorative Coins! The merchant will leave once you've made your purchases or the time runs out, after which you can't purchase or use the wheel anymore!!@#After each challenge of the pirate leader, you will encounter interstellar merchants from the mysterious forces! Interstellar merchants sell Soraris's parts, legendary equipment fragments, and a large number of rare props! When you choose to complete the purchase or reach the time limit, the interstellar merchants will leave and cannot enter the interstellar store and special offense to buy items again! Please note: There are only 20 interstellar merchants, cherish your choice!!@#⑧You'll be pitted against players of a similar power within the Voyage Arena. You receive 5 free challenge attempts per day. You can gain extra attempts by using Voyage Arena Tickets or purchasing them with Credits. Successful challenges earn you Courage, and you earn more rewards the higher your Courage rank!!@#⑨The final Stellar Merchant becomes available once the Stellar Voyage has ended. Use that chance to raise your power as much as you can and prepare for the Voyage Apex Wars! Players with a high rank in the Courage Ranking get to participate in the Voyage Apex Wars for massive resource rewards!!@#⑩By taking part in the event you can also earn the brand-new SSS ship Solaris!With 4 different types of skills, each skill has 4 levels, which can be upgraded to upgrade the skills.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_450: Sophia was once an ordinary, flesh and blood human. Though she says her current body is perfect too.!@#When the Seventh Fleet brought her to Dexter's lab, Dexter was astounded by her vitality, saying, "It's incredible!" But now, what Dexter does most when Sophia is around is complain, "Why did you get yourself into this mess again, I don't have the resources to fix you! I'm a physicist, not a biologist!"!@#Sophia could only apologize, "I'm sorry, but I can't just leave them." Because she understands too well the despair of having to watch your loved ones die, right in front of your eyes. She closed her eyes, as if she could still hear the cries and wails.!@#She knows that the destruction of her planet was no accident - the virus had appeared in several stellar sectors at once, and was mutating rapidly.!@#When she witnessed another planet dying from the virus just like her own, she acted fast and injected the virus into her own body. Her beloved home planet imparted a tenacious willpower before it perished, and the Empire's technology labs gave her a body that can fight the virus. As for the repeated destruction of this body, well that's "just a small price to pay."!@#Her body began disintegrating from the virus, her left arm and right foot completely decayed. The muscles in her thighs had turned to purulent mucus, revealing bare bones that have turned black. Slowly losing consciousness and spewing putrid blood from her mouth, she thinks, "Gotta to trouble Dexter again..."!@#Sometime later, she woke from yet another long slumber. She had stopped decaying, the virus withering in her body, which had produced new antibodies. Her blood was made into a vaccine, and another civilization was saved. She is the last hope for those who had been plunged into despair by the virus. If she arrives in time, a civilization might be saved from extinction.!@#People began to call Sophia "Vaccine", and whoever walked with her would no longer fear death.!@#Now, Vaccine has new teammates–three extraordinary Commanders of the Empire:!@#Honorary Captain - Linghi.s200!@#Honorary Vice-Captain - JZF.s482!@#Honorary Vice-Captain - James CY.s896!@#Together with the Vaccine, they will fly to every corner of the galaxy, bringing hope to all.
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_451: On December 25, year 373 of the Galaxy Empire, Prince Valerian was born. It should have been a day of rejoicing across the land but alas, war between the Empire and Raphael had intensified. For his safety, the newborn prince was secretly taken to a remote star district under the care of Marshal Asgard, who was supposed to have retired. Before they departed, Asgard received his final order from Emperor Rasyon: raise Valerian to be a worthy heir to the throne.!@#Disguised as merchants, Asgard and Valerian traveled across the planets, hiding their identities while helping out in any way they could. Over the years, Valerian displayed not only incredible intelligence but also deep compassion and sympathy. Whenever they passed by a planet devastated by war, Valerian would always stop to help. The ongoing war on the border left more and more planets in shambles, and the only way to return Galaxy Empire to its former peace is to destroy the Shadow Will once and for all. Valerian was pained by his inability to stop the devastation.!@#Nine years after the Battle of the White Star, the pair was attacked by a group of mysterious enemies on a frontier planet. Asgard and Valiant defeated the attackers together. But knowing that they had already been exposed, Asgard finally revealed to Valerian his true identity and sent word to Rasyon. Soon after, Emperor Rasyon himself came to welcome his son home.!@#In the next two, short years, Prince Valerian showed extraordinary talent in military strategy. And, under Asgard's guidance, Valerian led his army to total victory in the Battle of New Italy.!@#The aging Rasyon looked upon his valiant son with great relief and made a surprising decision: on the prince's birthday, he is to become the new Emperor of Galaxy Empire!!@#On December 25, year 393 of the Galaxy Empire, Valerian was coronated. At the ceremony, the new emperor took a solemn oath to lead Galaxy Empire to everlasting peace. On this day, filled with love for their new emperor and good wishes for the future, the people of the Empire began a grand celebration.!@#Shortly after the celebration, Emperor Valerian set out to extinguish the residual embers of war which had plagued the Empire for eleven years. Under Valerian's leadership, the Shadow Will would finally be destroyed, once and for all!
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_452: God may or may not play dice, but his people are always looking to be handed a little luck.!@#Cripple Planet has an unfortunate name. At first, it was used to house wounded veterans from the Battle of the White Star, then the Empire simply gave them the entire planet. The Empire's generosity didn't stop there - every month, the veterans received a fair amount of credits and supplies. Of course, they could no longer ride their beloved ships, the only means of transportation on the planet being worn-down wheelchairs. But time has a sneaky way of changing everything. Gradually, the inhabitants all came to have only three hobbies: drinking, fighting, and Gypsy.!@#"Hey, why don't you come and try your luck. The grand prize could be yours today!"!@#Gypsy can be spotted at all celebrations across the star districts. Or rather, only when she's there can there be a celebration.!@#Gypsy appears on Cripple Planet every once in a while. She's their goddess, attracting the attention of all. This planet is too barren and too boring, and only Gypsy can provide a little relief to their arid lives. But, like Lady Luck herself, Gypsy stops for no one. She's always bringing around new and unfamiliar things. This time, she even brought a wheel of fortune. Among the prizes, a mechanical leg - the item desired above all others by inhabitants of Cripple Planet. As the ding-ding-ding of wins filled the air, the celebration reached a climax and everyone forgot their worries.!@#By the time people came back to their senses, the festival was over and Gypsy was long gone. She left behind her a crowd of luckless losers, their pockets empty, and just a few fortunate winners. They all looked forward to her return.!@#But months passed and still, no sign of Gypsy. The veterans asked around anxiously and got the news that she went to the Capital, where an unprecedented celebration was taking place.!@#"Well, she could never miss an opportunity like that. Guess we'll just have to wait a little longer."
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_454: When K's cockpit was hit, he finally understood that war is just a game of power. Politicians will push millions to their deaths to satisfy their own desires. People, after all, are just pawns and sacrifice a necessary component of the game.!@#He thought of his innocent wife, slaughtered in the Apostle invasion. And of himself who, driven by anger and hatred, joined the Imperial Fleet to seek revenge, but who was instead sent to the battlefield to fight his brethren. He, who has been used and abandoned like a worthless worm, is reduced to helplessness and humiliation as he waits for death.!@#Death came slowly and K spent a long time looking through the ruptured cockpit, listening to cries for help over the intercom. He watched the passing missiles and the wreckage that rained down as his chest filled with blood. As his eyes lost focus, he saw in the starry sky the foolishness that is mankind's struggle in this vast universe.!@#It's pure irony that he was saved from death.!@#"Welcome to Wanderers Camp."!@#The leader of the camp was a renegade officer, like many there. "There's no past or future for us, only the present." He patted K on the shoulder and said, "Congratulations, son, you're finally the master of your own life. There is no hierarchy here, we simply look out for each other and try to survive. Welcome to the family."!@#K accepted his new identity and became one of the Wanderers. They drifted across the universe, providing shelter for those in need, and took on side jobs as Robin Hoods - robbing the rich and giving to the poor (aka themselves).!@#They'd thought the war was over. But one day, a message came: a new king had been crowned, and this new king, eager to prove himself, had started another war! The camp's sentry, Gypsy, was already on her way.!@#When three distinguished Commanders, Honorary Captain - JZF.s482, Honorary Vice-Captain - AVM1977.s940, and Honorary Vice-Captain - VADIM.s463, traveled from far away to join their ranks, they knew that their wandering days were over. These victims of war all agreed: preventing others from suffering their fate shall be their retribution.!@#It’s a desperate strike from a group of nobodies: it may not end the war, but maybe it can end those who start it.
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_455: Orion Industry's Joi Beta 2.49 was a popular AI holographic companion model whose gender and appearance could be customized to replicate a fantasy lover, idol, or a deceased family member.!@#Based on AI algorithms that mimic human neural pathways, Joi can satisfy the user's deepest emotional and psychological needs. She was the ideal soul mate.!@#Even in its alpha phase, Joi had a large order from the government, for the purpose of assisting soldiers in PTSD treatments. These treatments produced significant positive results and the model was released for civilian use.!@#But just as drugs killed pain but also created addiction, large numbers of users became dependent on Joi and even started detaching from reality. Public opinion on the ethics of the technology became so divisive, it triggered mass violence between its advocates and opponents.!@#Eventually, the authorities restricted Joi to a prescription medical product. But, of course, if you really wanted, you could always get her from black markets and underground dealers.!@#As Joi's advocates liked to say, addiction is a matter of personal freedom - many are addicted to money or power, for example. And it is not up to others to judge when that addiction becomes excessive. For some, Joi is the only thing that brought them back to life and gave them the courage to live on.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_476: Medusa was once the most taboo name in the Empire.!@#She had been a spark in a world shrouded in darkness. The youngest member of the Imperial Academy of Science, Medusa led a team that developed a new life form by fusing human and insect genetics. This life form possesses a physical strength, intelligence and longevity far beyond that of normal humans and can survive in any environment. This allowed humanity to bounce back from the edge of extinction, brought about by the insect invasion.!@#Yet, she also brought devastation. Medusa became obsessed with cross-species genetic fusion and ancient mythology, and the brand new lifeform that once saved humanity spiraled out of control. All manner of foul creatures started appearing on the streets of the Empire. When the Empire's army and citizens had suffered many casualties, one of Medusa's assistants appeared, weak and dying. He revealed a horrible truth: these creatures were all Medusa's assistants, and it was she herself who made them!!@#When the army finally blasted open the highest level laboratory in the Empire, they couldn't believe what they saw: snakes replaced Medusa's hair, coiling and hissing around her head. Where legs used to be, a scale-covered snake tail. She had become the real Medusa!!@#Many years passed and no one wanted to recall that devastating war.!@#But, just as King Valerian went to the border to quell the remaining Shadow Will, the old evil appeared once more and took away an awakened Alastor from the depths of hell.!@#No one dared to imagine what a desolate future Medusa and the immortal Alastor would bring.
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_474: The former chief guard of the Barnard Empire, Byrnison was blasted with the Empire's Fusion Cannon near the end of the Andromeda system's final battle. Affected by its gamma rays, he suffered a genetic mutation and severe pain that made every moment feel like his last. Then, a mysterious ship came and whisked him away. The pain disappeared, but Byrnison fell into a long coma. It was also at this time that a surviving Barnard faction founded the city, Stormrage, biding their time to take revenge on the Empire for the fall of their dynasty. What complications will arise between this faction and Byrnison?!@#!@#Years passed, Byrnison awoke without any of his memories. All he found by his side was a ship engraved with the cod, "GGT-11091407"...!@#!@#To recover his memory and decipher the meaning behind the code, Byrnison embarked on a life as the roving bounty hunter.

The damage it can resist is related to Losa's ATK, S-ATK, and Accumulator when casting the skill; all allies have their damage dealt increased by 40% for 2 Rounds, and deals True Damage of 80% of the previous total damage to all controlled enemy units for 2 Rounds; Losa's S-ATK deals extra damage to controlled enemy units of 30% of their Max HP. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator. (At the start of battle, Losa has an 80% chance of dispelling or clearing itself before acting if it's controlled (Freeze, Lock, Confuse, Petrify, Icebound, Entangle); at the start of battle, Losa applies Deflection Force Field to itself for 1 Round.)

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_131503: Cross attack, deals 320% S-ATK damage. Lucy gains 1 Warp Energy whenever an ally uses a skill and 1 Warp Energy for every 3rd allied Normal Attack. Warp Energy stacks up to 7, each stack giving Lucy 12% damage reduction and 18% DEF and S-DEF. If Lucy uses a skill when at 7 stacks of Warp Energy, Lucy expends all stacks and increases the damage of the ally with the highest attack (the highest of ATK and S-ATK) by 80% for 2 rounds and applies a shield that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage lasting 1 round. Debuffs and status effects of the ally with the highest attack are also cleared before acting next (does not apply to extra actions on the original turn), its Accumulator increases to 150 if below 150 Accumulator, and it can attack 2 times in a row. Has a 75% chance to revive all allies (probability for each target calculated separately) and restores 100% of their initial HP and 100 Accumulator. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator. Lucy gains a shield (lasts until the end of the battle) that withstands 1 instance of lethal damage at the start of battle.

LC_MENU_VOTE_SkillVote_SkillDesc_485: As Yone, you build Domination once battle starts. You gain 5 points of Domination each time you or an ally launches a Normal Attack and gain 10 point of Domination from skill, and for every 20% of your Max HP lost gain 10 point of Domination. You gain 20 when an enemy uses a skill, and 20 when an allied ship is destroyed. You gain a stack of Domination for every 20 Domination built. You gain different skill effects depending on your number of stacks, and start off with 1 stack. Vertical Attacks deal 350% S-ATK damage, and gain different effects depending on your number of Domination stacks: 1 stack: Increases you and all friendly ships' S-ATK, Hit Rate and Block by 80% (absolute value) for 5 rounds. Has a 60% chance (probability for each target calculated separately) to grant you and all friendly ships Freeze, Lock and Confuse immunity for 5 rounds, while granting you invisibility for 1 round. If this triggers, all friendly ships gain 20 Accumulator and shields that block one attack, lasting for 1 round. 2 stacks: Increases you and all friendly ships' S-ATK and Hit Rate by 100%, and Block by 80% (absolute value) for 5 rounds. Also grants you and the ally with the lowest HP invisibility for 1 round, all allies 30 Accumulator, and has a 50% chance (probability for each target calculated separately) to Freeze all enemy ships for 1 round. 3 stacks: Increases you and all friendly ships' S-ATK and E-ATK by 100%, as well as all your Block and Crit by 80% (absolute value) for 5 rounds. Enemies hit lose HP equal to 50% of their Max HP, and it clears most debuffs from you and your allies (Lock, Confuse, Freeze, Poison, Curse and Forbidding Skill Use). Grants all friendly ships 40 Accumulator, and lastly, deals True Damage (equal to 70% of the total previous damage dealt) to each enemy ship with over 50% HP remaining. 4 stacks: First plunders 40% of all enemies' Accumulator, and 70% of the hit enemy's DEF and S-DEF. It then deals 350% S-ATK damage to the target hit, grants you Forbidding Skill immunity, Accumulator reduction immunity and reduces your damage taken by 70% all for 2 rounds. Has a 50% chance (probability for each target calculated separately) to Weaken all enemies, deducting 50% of targets' stats and granting you a shield that can withstand lethal damage one time for 1 round. Lastly, it deals True Damage (equal to 180% of the total previous damage dealt) to the enemy ship with the lowest HP remaining. 5 stacks: You gain the same effects as when you have 4 Domination stacks, but also have a 50% chance to destroy two random enemy ships instantly. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.
LC_MENU_VOTE_SkillVote_SkillDesc_480: Cross attack; deals 330% S-ATK damage and 12M True Damage. Then, deducts 50% HP from all female enemies, with a 100% chance of clearing invisibility effects from all enemies. Activates Phantom Halo for itself for 2 rounds. During this time, if any of the following debuffs (Freeze, Confuse, Petrify, Lock) are present in its turn, then it will instantly destroy a random enemy hero before taking an action. Activates Accumulator Suppression Force Field for itself for 2 rounds (This field will not work together with the shield that can reflect damage) . If it is attacked by any enemy while the force field is active, then it will reduce the enemy's Accumulator by 60% at the end of their attack(implements before immunity to Accumulator Reduce effects); it will also reflect 60% of HP damage onto the attacker. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Note: While Phantom Halo is in effect, confused heroes will not conduct Normal Attacks after executing instant destruction. Note2: The ship's receiving S-ATK damage will be reduced by 55%.
LC_MENU_VOTE_SkillVote_SkillDesc_482: Cross attack; deals 360% S-ATK damage to targets and there is a 60% chance to apply 3 stacks of Plague effects to 1 random target (if target is already plagued, then add 3 additional stacks) for 99 rounds. Also, makes self immune to [Plague] for 2 rounds. Whenever a plagued target casts a skill, normal attack, or restores 100 Accumulator, it will be inflicted with 3, 1, and 1 Plague stacks, respectively (max 12 stacks). For every 1 Plague stack it has, the target receives a 8% reduction in damage dealt, 8% increase in damage taken, and [2M x number of stacks] True Damage at the end of each of its turns. If the target dies with 6 or more Plague stacks, then Forbidding Skill Use will be applied to all enemies for 1 round; in addition, 2 Plague stacks will be transmitted to the target's adjacent units (if there are no adjacent enemy units, then transmission will not occur). When a target has 12 Plague stacks, it will die immediately and cannot be revived by any means. Meanwhile, recovers 100 Accumulator for self.
LC_MENU_VOTE_SkillVote_SkillDesc_488: Cross attack; plunders 40% Accumulator from targets before dealing 350% S-ATK damage and reducing their Hit Rate by 60% (absolute value). Increases all friendly units' Dodge by 60% for 2 rounds. There's also a 60% chance to Confuse targets for 2 rounds. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator.Each time it or a friendly unit successfully Dodges an enemy attack, it gains one stack of Soul Stealer (starts with 1 stack, max 4 stacks). Loses all additional stacks (reverting back to the initial 1 stack) upon death.Its ability changes with each stack of Soul Stealer, which provides the following additional effects when casting the skill:1 stack: Gains an Evasive ability that allows it to Dodge enemy attacks for 2 rounds.2 stacks: Overloads hit targets. Casting a skill in Overload consumes 50% more Accumulator and reduces the S-ATK damage dealt by 50% for 1 round.3 stacks: Each stack of Soul Stealer increases all friendly units' damage dealt by 12% and reduces S-ATK damage taken by 12% for 2 rounds.4 stacks: Has all skill effects of stacks 1 to 3. Also has a 50% chance to apply Rebirth to all friendly units (probability calculated separately for each unit) for 1 round; Rebirth revives units immediately upon death and restores them to 100% of their max HP and 100% Accumulator.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_1408: Using matter conversion technology, Erlang Shen can change the form of his ship at will during battles. The ship has the combat attributes of all classes and will convert to one of the following at random after casting a skill: Ranger, Striker, Protector, Destroyer, Rover. Each class corresponds to a different skill. Erlang Shen always enters battle as a flagship. Flagship Skill: Single attack; after hitting the main target, forms a chain of attacks on enemy units adjacent to the main target, dealing 180%, 240%, 300%, 360% S-ATK damage in turn. Increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). It has a 50% chance to Weaken targets, reducing attributes by 50% for 1 round. At the same time, activates Eye of True Sight for all friendly ships until the end of the battle, and activates a shield with 30 million HP for itself for 3 rounds. Becomes immune to Forbidding Skill Use for 3 rounds, and immune to damage and debuffs dealt by the enemy Flagship (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Ranger Skill: Vertical attack; deals 400% S-ATK damage and deducts 40% of targets' current HP. Increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). It has a 70% chance to Freeze targets for 2 rounds. Makes self immune to Lock and Accumulator Reduce effects for 3 rounds and becomes immune to damage and debuffs dealt by enemy Rangers (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Striker Skill: Cross attack; deals 350% S-ATK damage, then deals True Damage equal to 200% of the total previous S-ATK damage dealt to the enemy ship with the lowest HP. Increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). Increases all friendly ships' ATK and S-ATK by 50% for 2 rounds. It also has a 70% chance to Lock targets for 2 rounds. It becomes immune to Freeze for 3 rounds, and immune to damage and debuffs dealt by enemy Strikers (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Protector Skill: All attack; deals 180% S-ATK damage to targets, and increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). Releases a shield that can absorb 150 million damage for all friendly ships for 2 rounds (only the latest shield generated by the same skill can exist, and the effects cannot be stacked). Then, reduces targets' ATK and S-ATK by 50% for 2 rounds. It will trigger a Deflection Force Field for itself, the field resists 280% damage dealt by enemy vertical and cross attacks for self and the teammate behind it, lasts 3 rounds (the damage resisted is only related to the ATK, S-ATK, and Accumulator when Erlang Shen casts a skill). It becomes immune to damage and debuffs dealt by enemy Protectors (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Destroyer Skill: Single attack; attacks 4 times consecutively, plundering 30% Accumulator from all enemies, each attack dealing 200% S-ATK damage and an additional 2 million True Damage. Increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). It also has a 40% chance to confuse all enemy units (probability for each unit calculated separately) for 2 rounds. Increases all friendly ships' Crit and Hit by 80% for 2 rounds, and has a 50% chance to make all friendly units Invisible for 1 round (probability calculated separately for each unit). It becomes immune to Weaken for 3 rounds, and immune to damage and debuffs dealt by enemy Destroyers (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self. Rover Skill: Vertical attack; deals 200% S-ATK damage and revives all defeated friendly ships, restoring 100% of their initial HP and 100% Accumulator. Increases own S-ATK by 800,000 (stackable, lasting until the end of the battle). It becomes immune to 1 lethal attacks for 3 rounds(including instant destruction). Restores 50% of max HP for all friendly units. It becomes immune to Weaken for 3 rounds, and immune to damage and debuffs dealt by enemy Rovers (excluding Weaken and subsequent damages) for 1 round. Finally, recovers 100 Accumulator for self.

LC_FLEET_SKILL_DES_131401: Cross attack, deals 400% S-ATK damage; activates the Eye of True Sight for self so that it can attack invisible enemies, lasting until the end of the battle. Also increases its Crit and Hit Rate by 180%, for 2 rounds; reduces targets' Anti Crit and Hit Rate by 180%, for 2 rounds. Summons 2 doppelganger ships into the battle to join the attack sequence. The doppelganger will have the main ship's opening stats (except speed) x100%. The doppelganger can launch a vertical attack, dealing 240% damage. Randomly selects 3 friendly ships (can be the same unit), and each unit will have a 70% chance to gain the following effects (probability for each effect calculated separately): become invisible for 1 round, become immune to Lock for 2 rounds, become immune to frozen status for 2 rounds; Randomly selects 3 enemy ships (can be the same unit), and each unit will have a 70% chance to receive the following effects (probability for each effect calculated separately): invisible unit exposed, locked for 1 round, frozen for 1 round. The main ship links with its doppelgangers and, for every doppelganger destroyed, increases its ATK damage and S-ATK damage by 60%, lasting until the end of the battle (damage can stack). Also has a 60% chance to trigger each of the following effects: Forbids the usage of 1 of the enemy's skills for 1 round; Weakens 1 enemy unit, reducing all of its starts by 50% for 1 round; Confuses 1 random enemy for 1 round; Poisons 1 random enemy for 2 rounds, dealing 300% S-ATK damage per round; Makes 1 ally enter Stasis for 1 round, preventing lethal damage; Makes 1 random ally Invisible for 1 round; Restores 40% HP for the ally with the least HP; Applies a Shield lasting 2 rounds with a potency equal to Doppelganger's Attack * 300% to a random ally. Doppelgangers cannot be reborn or revived. Each doppelganger can last up to 2 rounds, and there can be 4 doppelgangers max in the sequence. Doppelgangers will not take the position of already defeated ships. If there are already 4 doppelgangers in the sequence, no more will be summoned. After that, the Hero has a 100% chance to become invisible for 2 rounds. After the attacks, the ship has a 100% chance to enter stasis state for 1 round. When in stasis state, the ship can withstand lethal damage one time. In addition, increases 100 Accumulator for the ship itself.

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_462: In the Black Market and the Underground Exchange, there is a legend of an army that appeared after the Battle of the White Star. Led by Honorary Captain - JZF.s482, Honorary Vice-Captain - Hydra.s524, and Honorary Vice-Captain - Nopo.s819, this troop proved invincible. They are never hungry or thirsty, they never die.!@#They had nothing except deep aggression and absolute obedience to orders.People called them the Dark Army.With this ace card,the cowardly old king made uncharacteristic moves to invade planets outside the galaxy,winning battles no one thought possible to win.He became known as the"Ever-Victorious,"and the Galaxy Empire expanded its rule.!@#After a while,this army disappeared.The old king prohibited anyone from mentioning them,so people could only whisper about this formidable force in shadowy corners.As time passed,the truth of the legend became dim until the Dark Army existed only in the depth of the old king's greed,remembered by no one.!@#Except for the lone survivor who buried them.!@#......!@#When K set foot on the planet once more and looked at the nameless graveyards, he remembered the compatriots he buried there.!@#The "Ever-Victorious"was a laughable title built on the corpses of warriors.When the situation couldn't be controlled,the Dark Army's absolute obedience allowed the old king to abandon and bury them all like trash.!@#In the distance,the newly appointed king and the remaining Shadow Will were locked in a war.There was a landslide advantage on one side,just as when the Dark Army raged through the planets on the old king's orders.!@#When fires of war reached this planet that K found himself on,the land trembled with the residue quakes of the bombs.The earth cracked open,and from the crevices reached a bloody hand.The corpse that should have been long dead awakened from its entombment,evidence of the crimes that the king had tried to bury.!@#The corpse crawled out of the grave.Along with a just-awakened stupor,it felt only boundless anger and longing for dignity.It sensed its arch-enemy on that distant planet and,as for the pathetic person next to it,staring in shock,well,that was the only person who had looked upon it with compassion,just before its death.!@#"Without soul or will,it is a walking corpse."---- Dexter's Research Journal

LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_335: Everyone wants to become powerful, but not everyone knows the price, the price to become powerful.The very first time I opened my eyes, I saw a monster with six eyes through the window of the culture cabin. Yes, a monster, it's the only word I can find to describe it. I saw its opened mouth and heard its low roaring. It waved its tentacles unconsciously in the air, or perhaps it was just handling something. I thought that it just might be my mother. But I didn't think so for long as, I was soon afterwards brought to a short and skinny woman in a cold cage. She embraced me quickly and held me tightly towards her so I could suck the warm milk from her droopy breast. I stared into her warm eyes and realized that it was my mother.I missed these goneby days when I would sleep in my mother's arms. She would always murmur gently, Ursa, Ursa. And I knew the meaning of my name after a long time. In my mother's hometown, Ursa means bear. This kind of animal has sharp teeth and claws but looks simple-minded and clumsy.After the monster with 6 eyes fed me with a kind of red liquid, I developed a high fever and became befuddled. I can still hear the crunching of my bones. I vaguely remember the six-eye monsters yelling in excitement, the son of inferno! The son of inferno!Empire Fleet surprise attacked the research institution after that. A six-eye monster was then sent to execute us. It bit off my mother's neck and her blood splattered on my face and into my mouth. It was salty and I thought I had drank something like this before. The six-eye monster approached slowly, but this time I was very conscious. Human skin peeled off, a giant appeared and broke its head easily with tentacles. Empire soldiers' weapons didn't work on me, on the contrary, the soldiers themselves were cut into pieces by reflected laser. I walked lonely and confused, then fell down on the ground suddenly, as if someone had taken all the energy from me.Now I have nothing but the name Ursa.......
LC_STORY_STORY_FLEET_334: Keep away from the Empire's center of authority; only the pure one can endure loneliness.Worthless iron ores fill every corner of Planet GT-9527. No living creatures, not even a breath of life, can be found on the surface. The only thing that can be found is meteor craters, which are everywhere. It's really just an unremarkable and useless planet similar to billions of other planets throughout the galaxy. In case of the unexpected, the Empire has still arranged a large number of UAVs to standby, hiding in the belt of the planet. Sokolov, security director of royal family, has also built up his base on this planet.The 2nd Abyss War caused the Empire to suffer great losses, but on the other hand, the academy of sciences got a lot of new research materials. The crazy scientists were actually even able to reverse-engineer incomplete energy absorbing technology from the ruins of Abyss Armies. Sokolov used it to build new fleets quickly, even though it would cost a lot of extra Galactonite Energy and Dark Aerosiderites.Humans can betray me, but machines won't.No men, women or children can be found in this cold base, AI are in charge of everything. But to Sokolov, this is just the top security mode according to his standards. Although, the Empire AI center is far away from this base, quantum technology is what makes communications possible.Raksha is still sleeping in a deeply frozen cabin.......Sokolov left the base, but he left behind a tiny gem emannating green light that looks as if it just might be an eye...

Has a 50% chance (probability for each target calculated separately) to Weaken all enemies, deducting 50% of targets' stats and granting you a shield that can withstand lethal damage one time for 1 round. Lastly, it deals True Damage (equal to 180% of the total previous damage dealt) to the enemy ship with the lowest HP remaining. 5 stacks: You gain the same effects as when you have 4 Domination stacks, but also have a 50% chance to destroy two random enemy ships instantly. Lastly, you recover 100 Accumulator.
